name: crime_nearest
description: GetNearestCrimeSim / GetNearestCrimeProp (11.3), not a numbered 17 test. The occupant manager is asked for the box (pos.x - r, -FLT_MAX, pos.z - r)..(pos.x + r, +FLT_MAX, pos.z + r) with a filter: sims have type 0x496E5783 and occupant group 0x4102; props have type 0xA823821E and property 0x8AA864D5. best := radius; an occupant whose 3-D distance d < best and whose QI succeeds (sims 0xA9B40F05; props 0xE9793A65 with GetState() = 0) becomes the candidate with best := d. Distances by hand ([compat] order of 11.3, spec answer C8: sqrt((dy^2 + dz^2) + dx^2), each operation one float32 rounding): token 1 at (5,0,0) d 5, token 2 at (3,0,0) d 3 but its QI fails, token 3 at (0,4,0) d 4 (y is unbounded by the box), token 4 at (1,0,0) not in the group, token 5 at (20,0,0) outside the box. Radius 10 -> 3; radius 4 -> none (d < best is strict); radius 4.5 -> 3. Props: token 11 at (2,0,0) state 1 (rejected), token 12 at (0,0,3) state 0, token 13 at (1,0,0) without the property -> 12. Test 22 (by hand and an independent numpy float32 model): a sim at (2109, 1812, 3693): dy^2 + dz^2 = 3283344 + 13638249 = 16921593 -> f32 16921592, + dx^2 4447881 = 21369473 -> f32 21369472, sqrt -> 4622.7124 (0x459075B3); the order (dx^2 + dy^2) + dz^2 would give 0x459075B4. Radius 4622.712890625 (0x459075B4) -> returned (d < best); radius 4622.71240234375 (0x459075B3) -> none. A sim at (3, 4, 0) with radius 5: d = 5 -> none (strict); radius 5.000001 -> returned.
